name: Subtitles
description: Check, convert and re-time subtitle files (.srt, .vtt, .ass/.ssa). The check lists, with the line in the file, every cue that overlaps or runs backwards, has no text, is too long to read, or is shown too fast or too briefly (the usual broadcast limits: 42 characters a line, 2 lines, 20 characters a second, 0.83 to 7 seconds). Convert goes between the formats through ffmpeg. Shift moves every cue by milliseconds or seconds, or stretches the times to fix a frame-rate mismatch such as 25 vs 23.976. The original is never changed and the text of the cues is carried through untouched (tags, non-Latin text, right-to-left marks). Making the subtitles from the sound is in the Whisper tool (Transcribe to SRT), burning them into the picture in the ffmpeg tool (Burn subtitles).

presets.label: Check (timing, overlaps, reading speed)
presets.description: Lints a subtitle file: unreadable or backwards times, overlapping and out-of-order cues, empty cues, lines over 42 characters, more than 2 lines, reading speed over 20 characters a second, cues shorter than 0.83 s or longer than 7 s, and whether the file is UTF-8. Errors and warnings come back as file(line), with Fix with agent. Reads .ass/.ssa too.

presets.label: Convert to SRT
presets.description: Writes the subtitles as SubRip (.srt), the most widely accepted format.

presets.label: Convert to WebVTT
presets.description: Writes the subtitles as WebVTT (.vtt), the format of HTML5 video players.

presets.label: Convert to ASS
presets.description: Writes the subtitles as Advanced SubStation Alpha (.ass) with a default style, for styling by hand.

presets.label: Shift or stretch the times (write SRT)
presets.description: Type the amount in the extra arguments: +1500 or -800 (milliseconds), 2.5s (seconds), or a stretch for a frame-rate mismatch: *1.04271 or *25/23.976. A cue that would start before 0 is set to 0; one that would end before 0 is dropped (and counted).

presets.label: Shift or stretch the times (write WebVTT)
presets.description: The same as the SRT one, written as WebVTT. Extra arguments: +1500, -800, 2.5s, *1.04271 or *25/23.976.
